issues.desc: CHK-001 is framed as internal changed-file collection but does not state the user-observable output, such as where an operator sees the detected file list or how they can confirm active story overlaps were found.

CHK-003 and CHK-004 describe authority-boundary preservation and regression coverage, but their completion outcomes are not expressed in terms a user can recognize after the story completes; they should say what visible behavior or command output confirms the work is complete.
No checklist item declares userSees (precise observable output); add during PLAN so DEV verification targets concrete CLI text rather than abstract behavior.
CHK-001 exclusion criteria are vague ("exclude ... where appropriate"); pin down the exact ignore set (Lattice runtime/story metadata paths) in PLAN to avoid implementer judgment drift.

CHK-003 is a cross-cutting constraint rather than a discrete deliverable and partially overlaps CHK-004 non-authoritative assertion; acceptable, but PLAN should assign it concrete verifiable checks (e.g. grep/test that no authority mutation paths are touched).
